summary: NVIDIA announced that its Vera Rubin processor and Groq 3 LPX accelerator are now in full production, delivering a new efficiency benchmark—up to thirty times more work per watt—and ultra‑fast interactivity for long‑context, agentic AI models. Early adopters such as SpaceXAI are deploying the chips, while NVIDIA’s BlueField‑4 networking hardware underpins the scaling of massive AI‑agent fleets.
title: NVIDIA rolls out Vera Rubin CPU and Groq 3 LPX accelerator in full production, promising up to 30× higher work‑per‑watt for large‑scale agentic AI
